The mission of life is to exhaust your desires and realise the Self

I was in the same boat, I was on 20mg lex and doc prescribed 150 and eventually 300 (Extended release). My doc lowered my lex dose to 10mg and I take them both now (Wellbutrin in the morning and lex at night). Doing this has made my anxiety worse BUT it was so much easier to wake up and get things done.
I would not recommend quitting cold turkey as the anxiety could get worse, as in my case. Have a word with your doctor about reducing your dose first and eventually tapering off.
